blocks.text: Veteran host Joey de Leon was moved to tears during his 80th birthday celebration on “Eat Bulaga,” where he reunited with some of the celebrities he had worked with throughout his decades-long career. During the noontime show’s episode on Saturday, Oct. 10, de Leon was treated to a series of performances from program hosts, including Vic Sotto, Jose Manalo, Paolo Ballesteros, Jose Manalo, Allan K and Wally Bayola. De Leon was also surprised by Sharon Cuneta, Toni Gonzaga and Janno Gibbs who each serenaded the birthday celebrant. Other surprise guests included SexBomb Girls members, Jimmy Santos and Sen.
